help.repeat.more: On by default for repeaters, off for room servers.
help.ownerInfo: Who to contact about this repeater: your name, an RRY or ham radio callsign, or an email address. Anyone can read it without logging in, so only give details you are happy to share in public.
help.guestPassword.more: A guest password gives users access to owner info and neighbours. Empty by default.
help.adminPassword.more: Any node using it joins the admin list. The factory default is "password".
help.dutycycle: Share of airtime it may transmit. EU 868 MHz: 10 %.
help.dutycycle.more: How long the repeater stays silent after each transmission. Choose a value valid where you live. The firmware raises anything under 10 % to 10 % at every start. Firmware default is about 50 %.
help.floodAdvertHours: Announces itself across the mesh. 0 turns it off.
help.advertIntervalMinutes: Announces itself to direct neighbours. 0 turns it off.
help.advertIntervalMinutes.more: 60 to 240 minutes, in steps of 2. Default is 0.
help.allowance.tight: Floods reach only the repeaters close by.
help.floodMaxUnscoped: Most hops for a flood without a region.
help.floodMaxAdvert: Most hops for a flooded advert.
help.floodMaxAdvert.more: 0 to 64. The official tool lists 16 as default. Needs firmware 1.16 or newer.
help.floodMax: Most hops for any flood packet.
help.floodMax.more: 0 to 64. Following the hop preset: Tight 5, Minimal 10, Average 18, Extended 32, Full 64. The firmware default is 64.
help.pathHashMode: Size of the node IDs in packets.
help.pathHashMode.more: 1 byte: 256 IDs, up to 64 flood hops. 2 bytes: 65K IDs, up to 32 hops. 3 bytes: 16M IDs, up to 21 hops. Default is 1 byte. Needs firmware 1.14 or newer; older firmware drops packets with longer hashes.
help.loopDetect: Drops flood packets that seem to loop.
help.loopDetect.more: Off, minimal, moderate or strict, from lenient to strict. Default is off. Needs firmware 1.14 or newer.
help.directTxdelay.more: Delay factor, 0 to 2. The official tool lists 0.2 as default.
help.rxdelay: Wait before handling what it hears.
help.radioRxgain: Better reception for a little power.
help.radioRxgain.more: Boosted receive gain. Not every radio supports it.
help.agcResetInterval: Resets the receiver gain. 0 turns it off.
help.agcResetInterval.more: In seconds, rounded down to a multiple of 4. Default is 0.
help.txPower.more: Some boards add an amplifier. Too high may break local rules.
error.option: Pick one of the listed options.
error.tooLong: Too long. The admin password allows 15 bytes.
error.guestPasswordTooLong: Too long. The guest password allows 15 bytes.
error.controlChars: This text contains a tab or another control character. Remove it.
script.group.name: Name
backup.error.unknown: This file is not a configurator backup.
backup.error.newer: This backup comes from a newer version of the configurator.
backup.error.invalid: This backup is damaged or incomplete.
error.nameEmpty: Enter a name after the prefix.
error.nameControlChars: The name cannot contain tabs, line breaks or other control characters.
error.regionControlChars: A region code contains a control character. Choose the location again.
error.nameTooLong: The name is too long for the repeater.
error.ownerInfoTooLong: Too long. Owner info allows 119 bytes.
error.coordsRequired: Set the position: with Fixed position the advert sends the stored coordinates.
apply.adminPasswordMissing: Set an admin password, or tick Don't set a password.
app.title: #BEmesh configurator
step.name: Name
connect.title: Connect your repeater
connect.sub: Plug it in with a USB cable. Works in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
connect.noDevice: No device was chosen. If the list was empty: try another USB cable (some only charge), close other tabs that use the port (such as the flasher), and install the USB driver for your board.
connect.busy: The port is busy: another tab (such as the flasher) or another app has it open. Close it, unplug the board, plug it back in and connect again.
connect.noAnswer: Connected, but no MeshCore repeater answered. It may run other firmware (Companion or Meshtastic): flash Repeater firmware at flasher.meshcore.io. Or it is still starting or asleep: press its reset button, wait ten seconds and connect again.
connect.check.cable: Use a USB cable that carries data: some cables only charge.
connect.check.tabs: Close other tabs or apps that use the port, such as the flasher.
connect.check.driver: Install the USB driver your board needs: CP210x or CH340 on boards such as the Heltec V3 or the T-Beam.
connect.check.firmware: Flash MeshCore Repeater firmware at flasher.meshcore.io first.
connect.check.wake: Asleep or still starting? Press its reset button, wait ten seconds and connect.
connect.unplugged: The repeater was disconnected. Plug it in and connect again to continue.
connect.noSerial: This browser can't use USB (no Web Serial, as in Firefox and Safari). Use Chrome or Edge on a computer, or build the script here and enter it yourself.
read.title: Read settings from repeater?
read.hint: Your edits are replaced by what the repeater has. The admin password can't be read.
read.missing: No reply to: {commands}. Those fields keep the #BEmesh defaults.
read.regionsIncomplete: The region list may be incomplete. This repeater holds more regions than the firmware prints in one reply; the configurator asked for every region it knows by name, but a region with another name can be missing.
site.hilltop.desc: Clear view over a larger area: a mast, a ridge, the roof of a high-rise.
site.foothills.desc: Links hilltop nodes with those in town: a hillside, or a high roof outside town.
site.suburban.desc: A typical rooftop covering your own neighbourhood.
site.local.desc: Hears only a few others: indoors, ground level, a low roof.
site.custom.desc: Not one of the sites: the repeater's own timing, or the values in the fields below.
site.nearby: The map shows {count} repeaters within {km} km.
site.nearbyNone: Pick a place to see how many repeaters are nearby.
place.title: Where is your repeater?
place.sub: Search a place, or click the map and drag the pin.
place.outside: This spot is outside Belgium. The name prefix and the regions need a place in Belgium: search for one or move the pin.
place.name: Name
place.nearbyOk: ✓ No node within {km} km uses this name
place.nearbyTaken: ⚠ Name already used nearby: {name} is within {km} km.
place.nearbyUnchecked: Couldn't check nearby names: the node list did not load.
read.linkLost: the repeater was disconnected during the Read. Nothing was changed.
place.clearHint: Remove the coordinates: no position is sent to the repeater. The chosen place stays.
place.noBorders: The municipality borders didn't load. Use the search to choose the place.
regions.title: Which regions may it forward?
regions.sub: Allow the regions this repeater should flood, and deny the ones it should not.
regions.empty: Choose a location in the previous step to set the regions.
regions.free.parentInUse: Another region sits under this one.
error.freeCode.taken: That code is already in the list.
error.regionCount: The repeater holds at most {max} regions; this plan needs {count}.
regions.locked.municipality: Allow or deny your home municipality first.
regions.locked.province: Allow or deny your home province first.
regions.untagged.hint: Floods packets without a region (region allowf *). Turn it off only if your neighbours agree.
regions.home.inactive: Not an active function in the current firmware.
regions.default.hint: Its own flood adverts get this region, so they use the advert hop limit.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Starts from the #BEmesh recommendation, or from your repeater after a Read.
settings.adminPassword.placeholder: Leave empty to keep the current one
settings.adminPassword.placeholderNew: Set one for this new board
settings.adminPassword.skipWarn: Anyone who reaches it can log in with the factory password "password" and change it.
settings.ownerInfo.placeholder: e.g. ON4XYZ, or Jan RRY999 on the #BEmesh Discord
settings.radio.help: Every node in the mesh must share it. #BEmesh uses EU/UK (Narrow).
settings.summary.title: What will change
settings.map.caption: {place} · home region {code}
summary.name: Name
summary.adminPassword.kept: Admin password stays as it is
summary.adminPassword.factory: No admin password set: the factory password stays
error.radioInvalid: The radio settings are out of range.
settings.radio.invalid.sf: Spreading factor must be a whole number from 5 to 12.
settings.radio.invalid.cr: Coding rate must be a whole number from 5 to 8.
review.title: Ready to send to {name}
review.sub: Check the changes, then Apply. Apply also sets its clock to this computer's time, and you can restart the repeater at the end.
send.positionPublic: Its position ({lat}, {lon}) becomes public: anyone who hears its adverts sees it, and the #BEmesh map shows it.
send.positionGps: Its GPS position becomes public: anyone who hears its adverts sees it, and the #BEmesh map shows it.
send.positionNone: It shares no position, and a position stored on it is cleared.
review.sendAll: Send every setting, also the unchanged ones
apply.firmwareOld: This repeater runs MeshCore {version}. The region commands need MeshCore {min} or newer, so nothing was sent. Update the firmware at flasher.meshcore.io first.
apply.unknownBody: The firmware version could not be read. The region commands need MeshCore {min} or newer; on older firmware Apply stops partway.
apply.rebootNoDevice: Cannot reboot: the repeater is no longer connected.
apply.rebootSent: Reboot sent. The repeater restarts and disconnects; connect again to continue.
apply.clockSet: Its clock is set to this computer's time.
apply.clockAhead: Its clock runs ahead of this computer, and the firmware only moves a clock forward. Check it in Device tools.
apply.clockFailed: Couldn't set its clock: {reason}. Use Sync in Device tools.
desk.title: Then check it on the desk
desk.advert: Set a companion to EU/UK (Narrow) and send an advert from Device tools: the repeater shows up on the companion within a minute.
desk.name: It shows up as {name}.
desk.nameNoName: It shows up under the name you chose.
desk.regions: Read it again here: the check-up shows the regions you chose.
reboot.title: Configuration applied
reboot.radioHint: Radio or frequency changes need a reboot to take effect.
console.title: Console
console.showLogHint: Also log each command and reply during Read.
console.inputHint: One command per line (max {max} characters). Up/Down recalls history.
log.disconnecting: Command sent; the repeater is disconnecting.
apply.noLocation: Choose a location first: the region commands need one.
apply.tooLong: Nothing was sent: these commands are longer than the {max} bytes the repeater accepts. Shorten them first.
apply.copyRemainingHint: The copy starts with the failed command: it may not have taken effect.
apply.readAgain: Read the repeater again before applying again, so the script starts from what it has now.
tools.title: Device tools
tools.syncHint: Set the repeater's clock to this computer's time.
tools.synced: Clock set to this computer's time.
tools.noDevice: The repeater is no longer connected.
tools.otaConfirm: Start an over-the-air firmware update? The device enters OTA mode; follow your board's firmware upload steps (see the MeshCore FAQ).
tools.otaSent: OTA started. Connection closed — use your flasher, then reconnect.
tools.resetWarn: This erases the identity (private key) and ALL settings from the device. It cannot be undone: the device identity will be permanently lost.
tools.resetSent: Erase sent. Connection closed — reconnect after the device restarts.
vanity.title: Generate vanity key
vanity.hint: 1 to 4 hex characters (0-9, a-f). Longer prefixes take much longer.
vanity.invalid: Invalid prefix — use 1 to 4 hex characters (0-9, a-f).
vanity.notAllowed: Prefixes starting with 00 or ff are not allowed — MeshCore rejects those keys.
vanity.estimate: About {count} keys to try on average.
vanity.gaveUp: Gave up after {count} attempts. Try a shorter prefix.
vanity.writeQuestion: Write this new identity to the connected device now? This runs set prv.key; reboot the device to apply it.
vanity.written: Identity written; the device confirms public key {key}. Reboot the device to apply.
vanity.mismatch: The device reports a different public key ({got}) than expected ({want}). It has saved that key: generate and write a new one before it restarts.
random.title: Generate random key
random.hint: Creates a new random identity for this repeater. Nothing is written until you confirm.
identity.replaceWarn: This replaces the repeater's current identity. Its old private key is lost for good, and other nodes will see it as a new node. Back up the old private key first if you might still need it.
identity.backedUp: I have a backup of the old private key, or I don't need it
checkup.nameOnly: The name differs from the #BEmesh recommendation.
checkup.title: Quick check-up
checkup.subtitle: {name} compared with the #BEmesh recommendation
checkup.keep.title: Regions on this repeater that #BEmesh does not add
checkup.goesToo: Goes too: it needs a region you discard.
checkup.nameNote: Not ticked: people and the map know your node by its name.
checkup.timingNote: Pick another timing preset in Settings if the repeater is on a hill or in town.
checkup.needLocation: Choose a location in Place first
acl.title: Access list
acl.help: Keys on this list log in from the MeshCore app without the password.
acl.noRead: Without a Read, the keys you add are sent as additions. Keys already on the repeater stay; read it to change or remove those.
acl.undo: Reset the access list to what was read
acl.addPlaceholder: Paste a public key, or search a companion on the map…
acl.badKey: Not a public key: 64 hexadecimal characters
acl.duplicate: This key is already on the list
acl.full: The repeater keeps at most 32 entries; when full, it drops the least active non-admins.
